test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined word segment in the given sentence.

Her thinning grey hair was __hanging on__ her bony forehead.
solution:
The correct answer is 'straggling over' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the phrase 'hanging on' is incorrect.
 
• The word **'straggling over'** better describes the action of hair being spread out untidily over the forehead.
 
• Therefore, the phrase 'straggling over' should be used in place of the incorrect phrase 'hanging on'.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *Her thinning grey hair was **straggling over **her bony forehead*.
